title: Director of Quality (Aerospace & Defense)
text:
Join a long-established aerospace and defense manufacturer with over 80 years of proven performance supporting critical commercial, military, and space programs worldwide. The organization is a trusted supplier of advanced ducting systems and precision-engineered components used on some of the most demanding aviation and defense platforms.

You’ll step into a high-accountability
**Director of Quality**
role reporting directly to the CEO & President. You’ll lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, and the QMS interface, with a strong focus on in-process, incoming, and final inspection, NCMR/MRB, scrap reduction, supplier quality, corrective action, and day-to-day production support.

**Why This Role?**

* **Competitive Compensation:**
 **Base salary + 10% annual bonus target**
 , providing a strong compensation package for an experienced aerospace quality leader.
* **Strong Culture, Benefits & Onsite Amenities:**
 Work for an organization focused on
 **taking care of its people**
 , with an
 **onsite cafeteria**
 and competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA options,
 **401(k) with company match**
 , PTO, paid holidays, and sick leave.
* **Career Growth & Veteran-Friendly Culture:**
 Join an organization experiencing significant growth with opportunities to expand your leadership impact, while working in a
 **veteran-friendly environment**
 that values military experience, leadership, and technical expertise.
* **Major Space Projects:**
 Approximately
 **$250 million in space projects are currently underway**
 , providing strong visibility into future business and continued demand.
* **Trusted Aerospace Supplier:**
 Work with advanced commercial, military, and space applications.
* **Diverse Aerospace Programs:**
 Gain exposure to
 **commercial aviation, military aviation, and growing space programs**
 , creating a technically challenging and diversified manufacturing environment.
* **Executive-Level Visibility:**
 Report directly to the
 **CEO & President**
 and serve as a core member of the senior leadership team, giving you significant influence across the organization.
* **Hands-On Quality Leadership:**
 This is a
 **factory-focused quality leadership role**
 , where you will directly influence incoming, in-process, and final inspection, NCMR/MRB, supplier quality, corrective action, and scrap reduction.
* **Broad Technical Environment:**
 Work across
 **metal fabrication, welding, NDT, machining, grinding, honing, broaching, and electro-mechanical assembly**
 while partnering with Engineering, Operations, Production, and Supply Chain.
* **High-Impact Quality & Supplier Leadership:**
 Lead initiatives addressing
 **scrap, customer complaints, incoming material rejections, production quality, supplier performance, root cause analysis, and corrective action**
 .
* **AS9100 & Continuous Improvement:**
 Apply practical
 **AS9100 Rev. D**
 experience while driving zero-defect quality planning, process improvement, audit readiness, and measurable manufacturing improvements.
* **Strong People-Focused Culture:**
 Join a company with a strong focus on
 **taking care of its people**
 , a veteran-friendly environment, onsite cafeteria, and opportunities to build a long-term career.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead the Quality organization across
 **Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, QMS, and Test**
 , with a primary focus on factory-floor execution.
* Drive improvements in
 **incoming, in-process, and final inspection**
 , NCMR/MRB review and disposition, scrap reduction, customer complaints, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Production, and suppliers to resolve quality issues and ensure customer requirements are effectively translated to the manufacturing floor.
* Lead the
 **Repairs & Overhauls (R&O)**
 function through completion, customer commitments, tooling/equipment disposition, and orderly close-out.
* Develop and lead the Quality organization while maintaining AS9100 readiness, supplier performance, customer satisfaction, and overall manufacturing quality.

**What You Bring:**

* **10+ years of quality experience**
 in a
 **low-to-medium volume precision production manufacturing environment**
 , with the majority of your career spent running quality operations on the factory floor.
* Strong aerospace manufacturing background with experience supporting
 **machining and assembly of precision components**
 .
* Demonstrated
 **Director-level or senior management experience**
 leading quality within a manufacturing plant.
* Must-have technical depth in
 **NCMR/MRB review and disposition, incoming/in-process/final inspection, supplier quality management, root cause analysis, corrective action, and scrap reduction**
 .
* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in
 **Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Technology, or a related field**
 . Practical
 **AS9100 Rev. D**
 QMS experience is essential.
